incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> runtime-edge-high-latency (prod). count=1, recent spikes at 2m. PD incident #54321. auto-escalate if unacked.
jamie: acked. I’m on it :eyes:
ankit: seeing short 95p latency blips on proxy, spikes ~350-420ms for ~30-90s. no 5xx in logs so far.
jamie: no deploys in the last hour. checking health endpoints...
jamie: `curl -sS https://runtime-internal/_health | jq .` -> {"status":"ok", "kv_cache":"warming"}
ankit: kv_cache warming note matches small tail latency. correlates with traffic ramp to a few routes.
lucy: tagging for visibility — if it’s just warming and no customer errors, treat as noisy/suppression candidate. keep oncall watch for 15m.
dan: quick check in Sentry — no uptick in error rates or customer-facing traces. only latency spans in internal traces.
jamie: got two more PD pages but both auto-resolved (PD shows brief re-fires). seems threshold is pinging on short-lived tails.
ankit: logs snippet: ```[2026-03-17T12:34:05Z] proxy latency=0.42s route=/chat model=redwood-v1```. repeated small bursts for ~2m.
jamie: I'm going to soft-ack and suppress PD for 15m (we have auto-silence) unless we see 5xx or user-visible errors.
lucy: +1. if it reappears as sustained >3m we escalate. otherwise file tuning ticket.
jamie: created ENG-987: tune runtime-edge-high-latency alert window to reduce sensitivity to kv-warmup. linking notes and grafana snapshots.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident #54321 auto-resolved (all checks normal).
jamie: :thumbsup: marking thread resolved for now. Will follow up on alert config and add a comment with suggested thresholds.
ankit: thanks — will keep an eye on kv prefill improvements to reduce this.
lucy: noted for postmortem-free doc. no customer impact observed. closing check-in in 15m.
